property.name: dfs.replication
property.description: So ban sao cua moi block. Dat 1 khi moi khoi dong, tang len 2 khi co du 2 DataNode dang chay.

property.name: dfs.blocksize
property.description: Kich thuoc block 128 MB, phu hop cho CSV va Parquet lon.

property.name: dfs.namenode.use.datanode.hostname
property.description:
Bat hostname thay vi IP khi NameNode giao tiep voi DataNode.
Tren Docker Desktop, cac worker khac nhau co the bi NAT thanh cung mot IP noi bo. Dieu nay khien NameNode xem nhieu DataNode la cung mot node.
Su dung hostname nhu datanode1 va datanode2 se tranh duoc van de trung IP.
Yeu cau: - NameNode phai resolve duoc datanode1 va datanode2 - Them extra_hosts trong docker-compose

property.name: dfs.datanode.use.datanode.hostname
property.description:
DataNode dang ky voi NameNode bang hostname thay vi IP socket.
Can dung cung voi: dfs.namenode.use.datanode.hostname=true

property.name: dfs.client.use.datanode.hostname
property.description:
HDFS client nhu Spark va Jupyter se su dung hostname de doc va ghi block truc tiep.
Dam bao container client resolve duoc datanode1 va datanode2.

property.name: dfs.datanode.socket.write.timeout
property.description: Tang timeout ghi socket cho moi truong Tailscale.

property.name: dfs.client.socket-timeout
property.description: Tang timeout cho HDFS client tren Tailscale.

property.name: dfs.namenode.heartbeat.recheck-interval
property.description: Kiem tra heartbeat moi 30 giay de tranh false alarm.

property.name: dfs.namenode.stale.datanode.interval
property.description: DataNode khong heartbeat trong 60 giay moi bi danh dau stale.
